### Proven

- Substrate 1.11.4 → 1.12.0 step: `agentlab substrate-step-test --to 1.12.0` from 4.139.0 with the drain case on, all 8 stages pass: a suspended conversation resumes during the drain with its earlier turns, its volume file intact, and the golden is kept in layout 2 ([details](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/1053)).
